Trust can end before access does. Accounts set up for a shared life can outlast it. Toza finds, with you and in person, what still connects you. A family cloud that still shares photos and documents.A recovery number or email that belongs to your spouse.An old phone or tablet still signed in to your messages.Location sharing set up years ago. Change things in the right order. A password change can leave another route open, and changing a family service can cut access you rely on. You agree the sequence together before anything changes.
